{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast
completed_orders['revenue_numeric'] = completed_orders['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for any remaining invalid values
print("Invalid revenue values (non-numeric after cleaning):")
invalid_revenue = completed_orders[~completed_orders['revenue_numeric'].apply(lambda x: isinstance(x, (int, float)))]
print(invalid_revenue)

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_numeric'].mean()

# Output the result
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders: {mean_revenue}")"}
